evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds an optional sat_vb argument across several RPC endpoints (getmempoolinfo, getnetworkinfo, estimatesmartfee, estimaterawfee).
rationale: Allows callers to receive feerates in sat/vB rather than BTC/kvB, eliminating downstream conversion workarounds and sub-1 sat/vB precision loss. Downstream tooling widely prefers sat/vB, but existing clients can continue using BTC/kvB without disruption.
